title: Choose the /products layout
question: Three layouts for the Products page, all in the site's existing dark look. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Shared spine
options.thesis: Sai Server and Sai Play face each other, joined by one Sai account in the middle.
options.viewport: Two equal product panels with a vertical blue spine labelled One Sai account + sGem between them.
options.risk: Equal weight underplays Sai Server, the product studios came for.

options.label: Player journey
options.thesis: Follow one player from a studio's game on Sai Server to their account on Sai Play.
options.viewport: Headline 'Build on Sai Server. Your players land on Sai Play.' over three numbered steps and two buttons.
options.risk: No product imagery above the fold; relies on copy.

options.label: Two-sided switcher
options.thesis: Pick your side: 'I make games' shows Sai Server, 'I play games' shows Sai Play.
options.viewport: Left: headline and two side tabs; right: the selected product's panel with image, text and button.
options.risk: Sai Play hides behind a click; needs a no-JS fallback.
